stem: An analyst reports a 12-month gross revenue retention of 103% for Business Care, Voltmarkt's device-support subscription for small offices. What does this show?

options.text: The calculation is wrong, since capping each business keeps GRR at 100% or below
Upgrades by existing businesses outweighed all of their cancellations and downgrades
Business Care signed more new businesses than it lost over the 12 months
No business in the starting cohort cancelled or moved to a cheaper plan
